message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. MFA for admins blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. MFA for database admins then blocks authentication to DB, fileserver, and backup, including when stolen_dbadmin is obtained through the CI server. Thus all exfiltration routes are blocked. No single control suffices: segmentation can be bypassed through an unpatched workstation; any single patch leaves other routes available; user MFA is bypassed by the always-available workstation or laptop phishing footholds; admin MFA alone leaves the CI-secret route open; and database-admin MFA alone can be bypassed after compromising DC or ADFS."}
